points.quote: This layer doesn't depend on AFFiNE's block types.
`std` is the standard editor runtime. It provides the view layer, the dependency-injection container, the extension mechanism, selection, commands and the gfx (canvas) base.
`widgets/*`: UI overlays such as the toolbar, slash-menu, drag-handle... `fragments/*`: side panels such as outline, frame-panel, doc-title
The app is wired in as workspace dependencies. `packages/frontend/core/package.json` depends on `@blocksuite/affine`...
